_authority: The canonical files every module carries in its own assets/ folder - copied byte for byte by scripts/design_system.py, never retyped and never read in full by the model. references/vocabulary.md is what the model reads instead. Edit this list, not the script.
_why: Phase 5 step 11b. Establishing the visual system used to mean the model read about 82 KB of style files (~20,000 tokens) it only needed to copy. Reading them buys nothing: a copy is either identical or it is a second dialect. The script copies, the check proves identity, and the vocabulary keeps every composition and component in view.
_rule: A module's copy is never edited. If something genuinely shared is missing, add it to the canonical file in the plugin and re-install; course-specific styling goes in the module's own stylesheet, loaded after these.
_not_the_terminal_engines: These are the MODULE's own delivery files, which modules have always carried in their own assets/ (course-module-ux build/GUIDE.md, course-task-ux section 14). They are not the tablet terminal's shared engines - gb_nav.js, gb_sync.js, gb_tasks.js, gb_config.js and the rest at the terminal root - which live once in the app and are never copied into a course (course-tablet-publisher knowledge/platform.json shared_engine_globs). No name below is one of those.

files.name: gb_tokens.css
files.for: every page - the token set, loaded first

files.name: gb_compose.css
files.for: what sits on a deck screen - compositions and blocks

files.name: gb_page.css
files.for: document pages and the frame of task pages

files.name: gb_task.css
files.for: task controls, on top of gb_page.css

files.name: kbd_escape.js
files.for: the three ways out of the soft keyboard

starter_deck._note: written only when the module has no module.html yet, and never checked for identity afterwards - it is the deck the module is built in

_record_note: For a module in course/modules/ the record goes to course/working_claude/modules/<module>/design_system.json, so the module folder holds only the module (L44, 2.20.0) - course-factory/scripts/workspace.py module_record()
